period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements as at and for the 1st Quarter ended 31 March 2020"), downloaded directly from the bank's live financial-statements archive (legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements), not Wayback Machine. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2020' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the 1st Quarter ended 31 March 2020') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 349,677,519,435 + Shareholders' equity 25,879,692,458 = Total assets 375,557,211,893 exactly; Net interest income 2,672,580,201 + Investment income 819,377,690 + Commission 727,297,099 + Other operating income 613,889,062 = Total operating income 4,833,144,051 (source document's own subtotal, off by 1 taka from the component sum due to rounding in the original); Profit before provision of 1,873,074,315 also reconciles exactly to the Cash Flow Statement's own 'Profit before provision' starting line. Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1 (identical to a discrete quarter for Q1 specifically). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). This filing includes an explicit Note 4.a 'Net Assets Value per Share (NAV) - The City Bank Limited' (Solo basis), so nav_per_share is reported here (not calculated); it also discloses (Note 7) a BSEC-mandated 'significant deviation between two quarterly periods' explanation attributing the YoY rise in investment income to higher interest income on government securities from increased Treasury Bill/Bond holdings.
